passages.text: Now the whole world had one language and a common form of speech.
passages.sermon: All people on earth spoke one language.\r\nEveryone used the same words.\r\nThe whole world shared a single way to speak.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִ֥י כָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ שָׂפָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּדְבָרִ֖ים אֲחָדִֽים׃

passages.text: And as people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
passages.sermon:
All the people traveled together.
They moved eastward.
They found a plain.
This plain was in the land of Shinar.
They settled there.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִ֖י בְּנָסְעָ֣ם מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַֽיִּמְצְא֥וּ בִקְעָ֛ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֖ר וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: And they said to one another, “Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly.” So they used brick instead of stone, and tar instead of mortar.
passages.sermon:
All the people on earth spoke one language.
They traveled together and settled in the land of Shinar.
The people spoke to each other.
They said, “Come, let us make bricks.
Let us bake the bricks well.”
They used bricks as building stones.
They used tar as mortar.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֗הוּ הָ֚בָה נִלְבְּנָ֣ה לְבֵנִ֔ים וְנִשְׂרְפָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵפָ֑ה וַתְּהִ֨י לָהֶ֤ם הַלְּבֵנָה֙ לְאָ֔בֶן וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ר הָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לַחֹֽמֶר׃

passages.text: “Come,” they said, “let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens, that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth.”
passages.sermon:
A group of people lived together in the land of Shinar.
They spoke the same language.
They said to each other, “Come, let us build a city for ourselves.”
They also said, “Let us build a tower.”
They wanted the top of the tower to reach the heavens.
They said, “Let us make a name for ourselves.”
They did not want to be scattered over the whole earth.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ הָ֣בָה׀ נִבְנֶה־ לָּ֣נוּ עִ֗יר וּמִגְדָּל֙ וְרֹאשׁ֣וֹ בַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנַֽעֲשֶׂה־ לָּ֖נוּ שֵׁ֑ם פֶּן־ נָפ֖וּץ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
God came down from heaven.
God wanted to see something on earth.
People were building a city.
People were also building a tower.
The sons of men built the city and the tower.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣רֶד יְהוָ֔ה לִרְאֹ֥ת אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־ הַמִּגְדָּ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃

passages.text: And the LORD said, “If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD saw the people.
The people were united as one group.
All the people spoke the same language.
The people had started to build the city and the tower together.
The LORD said, “They are one people.
They all have one language.
They have begun to do this work together.
Now nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה הֵ֣ן עַ֤ם אֶחָד֙ וְשָׂפָ֤ה אַחַת֙ לְכֻלָּ֔ם וְזֶ֖ה הַחִלָּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת וְעַתָּה֙ לֹֽא־ יִבָּצֵ֣ר מֵהֶ֔ם כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָזְמ֖וּ לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

passages.text: Come, let Us go down and confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another’s speech.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke.
The LORD said, "Let Us go down."
Let Us confuse their language there.
They will not understand each other's speech.
passages.original: הָ֚בָה נֵֽרְדָ֔ה וְנָבְלָ֥ה שָׁ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפַ֥ת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD scattered the people from that place.
The LORD spread them over the whole earth.
The people stopped building the city.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨פֶץ יְהוָ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם מִשָּׁ֖ם עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּחְדְּל֖וּ לִבְנֹ֥ת הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: That is why it is called Babel, for there the LORD confused the language of the whole world, and from that place the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth.
passages.sermon:
The city is called Babel.
The LORD confused the language of the whole world there.
The LORD scattered the people from that place.
He spread them over the face of all the earth.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּי־ שָׁ֛ם בָּלַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה שְׂפַ֣ת כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּמִשָּׁם֙ הֱפִיצָ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

passages.text: This is the account of Shem. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
passages.sermon:
Shem was a man who lived after the flood.
Shem was 100 years old two years after the flood.
At that time, Shem became the father of Arphaxad.
This is the account of Shem.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת שֵׁ֔ם שֵׁ֚ם בֶּן־ מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֔ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֑ד שְׁנָתַ֖יִם אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Shem was the son of Noah.
Shem became the father of Arphaxad.
After Arphaxad was born, Shem lived 500 years.
Shem had other sons and daughters during those years.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ שֵׁ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֔ד חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.
passages.sermon:
Arphaxad was a man.
Arphaxad was the son of Shem.
Arphaxad lived after the great flood.
Arphaxad reached the age of 35 years.
When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.
passages.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֣ד חַ֔י חָמֵ֥שׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ שָֽׁלַח׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Arphaxad was a man.
Arphaxad became the father of Shelah.
After Arphaxad became the father of Shelah, he lived 403 years.
Arphaxad had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֣י אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֗ד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ שֶׁ֔לַח שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: When Shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of Eber.
passages.sermon: Shelah was a man.\r\nShelah lived for 30 years.\r\nShelah became the father of Eber when he was 30 years old.
passages.original: וְשֶׁ֥לַח חַ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ עֵֽבֶר׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Shelah was a man in the generations after the flood.
Shelah became the father of Eber.
After Shelah became the father of Eber, he lived 403 years.
Shelah had other sons and daughters during these years.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ שֶׁ֗לַח אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ עֵ֔בֶר שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: When Eber was 34 years old, he became the father of Peleg.
passages.sermon: Eber was a man in the line of Shelah.\r\nEber lived for 34 years.\r\nEber became the father of Peleg.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ עֵ֕בֶר אַרְבַּ֥ע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ פָּֽלֶג׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Eber was a man in the line of Shem.
Eber became the father of Peleg.
After Eber became the father of Peleg, he lived 430 years.
During these 430 years, Eber had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ עֵ֗בֶר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ פֶּ֔לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: When Peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of Reu.
passages.sermon: Peleg was a man.\r\nPeleg lived for 30 years.\r\nPeleg became the father of Reu.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ פֶ֖לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ רְעֽוּ׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Peleg was a man in the line of Shem.
Peleg became the father of Reu.
After Peleg became the father of Reu, he lived 209 years.
Peleg had other sons and daughters during these years.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ פֶ֗לֶג אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ רְע֔וּ תֵּ֥שַׁע שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: When Reu was 32 years old, he became the father of Serug.
passages.sermon: Reu was a man in the line of Shem.\r\nReu lived for 32 years.\r\nReu became the father of Serug.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֣י רְע֔וּ שְׁתַּ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ שְׂרֽוּג׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Reu was a man in the Bible.
Reu became the father of Serug.
After Serug was born, Reu lived 207 more years.
Reu had other sons and daughters during these years.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֣י רְע֗וּ אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ שְׂר֔וּג שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.
passages.sermon: Serug was a man.\r\nSerug lived for 30 years.\r\nSerug became the father of Nahor.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֥י שְׂר֖וּג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ נָחֽוֹר׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Serug was a man in the genealogy from Shem to Abraham.
Serug became the father of Nahor.
After Serug became the father of Nahor, he lived 200 years.
Serug had other sons and daughters during these years.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֣י שְׂר֗וּג אַחֲרֵ֛י הוֹלִיד֥וֹ אֶת־ נָח֖וֹר מָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: When Nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of Terah.
passages.sermon: Nahor was a man.\r\nNahor lived for 29 years.\r\nNahor became the father of Terah.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֣י נָח֔וֹר תֵּ֥שַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ תָּֽרַח׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Nahor was a man.
Nahor became the father of Terah.
After Nahor became the father of Terah, he lived 119 years.
Nahor had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֣י נָח֗וֹר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ תֶּ֔רַח תְּשַֽׁע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: When Terah was 70 years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
passages.sermon:
Terah was a man.
Terah became a father.
Terah was 70 years old.
Terah had three sons.
Their names were Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ תֶ֖רַח שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֙וֹלֶד֙ אֶת־ אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת־ נָח֖וֹר וְאֶת־ הָרָֽן׃

passages.text: This is the account of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
passages.sermon: Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.\r\nHaran was the father of Lot.\r\nThis is the family record of Terah.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת תֶּ֔רַח תֶּ֚רַח הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת־ נָח֖וֹר וְאֶת־ הָרָ֑ן וְהָרָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ לֽוֹט׃

passages.text: During his father Terah’s lifetime, Haran died in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
passages.sermon:
Haran was Terah’s son.
Haran died while his father Terah was still alive.
Haran died in his native land.
Haran’s native land was Ur of the Chaldeans.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣מָת הָרָ֔ן עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י תֶּ֣רַח אָבִ֑יו בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתּ֖וֹ בְּא֥וּר כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃

passages.text: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves. Abram’s wife was named Sarai, and Nahor’s wife was named Milcah; she was the daughter of Haran, who was the father of both Milcah and Iscah.
passages.sermon:
Abram and Nahor were sons of Terah.
Abram took a wife.
Nahor also took a wife.
Abram’s wife was named Sarai.
Nahor’s wife was named Milcah.
Milcah was the daughter of Haran.
Haran was the father of Milcah.
Haran was also the father of Iscah.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָ֧ם וְנָח֛וֹר לָהֶ֖ם נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת־ אַבְרָם֙ שָׂרָ֔י וְשֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת־ נָחוֹר֙ מִלְכָּ֔ה בַּת־ הָרָ֥ן אֲבִֽי־ מִלְכָּ֖ה וַֽאֲבִ֥י יִסְכָּֽה׃

passages.text: But Sarai was barren; she had no children.
passages.sermon: Sarai was Abram’s wife.\r\nSarai could not have children.\r\nSarai was barren.
passages.original: וַתְּהִ֥י שָׂרַ֖י עֲקָרָ֑ה אֵ֥ין לָ֖הּ וָלָֽד׃

passages.text: And Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai the wife of Abram, and they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans for the land of Canaan. But when they arrived in Haran, they settled there.
passages.sermon:
Terah was Abram’s father.
Terah took Abram, his son.
Terah took Lot, his grandson.
Lot was the son of Haran.
Terah took Sarai, his daughter-in-law.
Sarai was Abram’s wife.
They all left Ur of the Chaldeans together.
They planned to go to the land of Canaan.
They reached Haran.
They settled in Haran.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח תֶּ֜רַח אֶת־ אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֗וֹ וְאֶת־ ל֤וֹט בֶּן־ הָרָן֙ בֶּן־ בְּנ֔וֹ וְאֵת֙ שָׂרַ֣י כַּלָּת֔וֹ אֵ֖שֶׁת אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּצְא֨וּ אִתָּ֜ם מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ אַ֣רְצָה כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ עַד־ חָרָ֖ן וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Haran.
passages.sermon: Terah was Abram’s father.\r\nTerah lived for 205 years.\r\nTerah died in Haran.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ יְמֵי־ תֶ֔רַח חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּ֥מָת תֶּ֖רַח בְּחָרָֽן׃ס
